===================================================
  Submit and Run A Batch CPU Job in Vanda Cluster
===================================================

[1;31m  --- Sample job submission script [job1.txt] in GREEN starts from the below line -->> [0m
[1;32m#!/bin/bash [0m
[1;32m#PBS -P Project-Name [0m
[1;32m##PBS -q auto_free [0m
[1;32m#PBS -j oe [0m
[1;32m#PBS -k oed [0m
[1;32m#PBS -N Job_name [0m
[1;32m#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00 [0m
[1;32m#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=36:mpiprocs=36:ompthreads=1:mem=240gb [0m
[1;36m### Example for requesting 72 cores for the job: [0m
[1;36m###PBS -l select=1:ncpus=72:mpiprocs=72:ompthreads=1:mem=480gb [0m
[1;36m# [0m
[1;36m### To submit job to [auto_free] queue, delete '-P Project-Name' line, and 
[1;36m###    activate this line '-q auto_free' by changing to #PBS -q ... [0m

[1;32mcd $PBS_O_WORKDIR; [0m

[1;32m## load module [0m
[1;32mmodule load HPL/2.3-intel-2023b [0m

[1;32m## run command [0m
[1;32mmpirun  xhpl   [0m
[1;31m  <<--- End at the above line with EOF ----- [0m

 Replace Project-Name with real project name allocated. You can check 
   the available project name via:  hpc project 

 Make necessary changes to the above script file [job1.txt], then 
 you can submit the job, check job status, and check cluster loading status by:

  # [1;32mqsub  job1.txt     ##--- To submit a batch job via script <job1.txt> [0m
  # [1;32mqstat -awn1        ##--- To list batch jobs with wide format and show exec nodes [0m
  # [1;32mqstat -fx job_id   ##--- To list details of a batch job <job_id> [0m
  # [1;32mhpc gstat          ##--- To check overall loading status of hopper cluster and queue  [0m


[1;31m More examples and instructions are available at this URL: [0m

 https://nusit.nus.edu.sg/hpc/ --> Vanda Onboarding.



=== hpc_gpu ===

===================================================
  Open An Interactive Job in Vanda GPU Node
===================================================
 To run short interactive AI jobs meant for debugging of code on GPU,
 Following the below 3 Steps.

 Step 1:  Launch a login session on GPU system by entering the below command:

   [Vanda]> [1;32mqsub -I -P Project-Name -l select=1:ngpus=1 -l walltime=01:00:00 [0m

   where 
         -I                  :  Launch in interactive session
         -P Project-Name     :  Set to use project < Project-Name, e.g. CFP01-CF-nnn or personal-usernage > 
         -l select=1:ngpus=1 :  Request for 1 GPU ONLY for the session, including
                                1 CPU with 36 cores, 250gb mem.
         -l walltime=**      :  Request walltime max up to 2 hours

   The default walltime for such session is 1 hour, and max to be 2 hours.
   To use a full GPU node (2 CPUs and 2GPUs), use this command:
   [Vanda]> [1;32mqsub -I -P Project-Name -l select=2:ngpus=1 -l walltime=01:00:00 -l place=pack [0m

 Step 2:  Open Singularity container on Hopper (GPU) Server by:

   [gn-a40-xxx]> [1;32mmodule load msingularity [0m
   [gn-a40-xxx]> [1;32msingularity exec -e /app1/common/singularity-img/vanda/pytorch_2.5_cuda_12.4_unsloth.sif bash [0m

   or

   [gn-a40-xxx]> [1;32msingularity exec -e /app1/common/singularity-img/hopper/pytorch/pytorch_2.3.0_cuda_12.4_ngc_24.04.sif bash [0m

   You can list other AI/DL containers in folder < /app1/common/singularity-img/hopper/ >. 

 Step 3:  Start and run your AI/DL python program:

   # [1;32mpython cifar10_resnet.py [0m


===================================================
  Submit and Run A Batch GPU Job in Vanda Cluster
===================================================

[1;31m  --- Sample job submission script [job1.txt] in GREEN starts from the below line -->> [0m
[1;32m#!/bin/bash [0m
[1;32m#PBS -P Project-Name [0m
[1;32m##PBS -q auto_free [0m
[1;32m#PBS -j oe [0m
[1;32m#PBS -k oed [0m
[1;32m#PBS -N Job_name [0m
[1;32m#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00 [0m
[1;32m#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=36:mpiprocs=1:ompthreads=36:ngpus=1 [0m
[1;36m### Example for requesting 2 GPUs: [0m
[1;36m###PBS -l select=1:ncpus=72:mpiprocs=1:ompthreads=72:ngpus=2 [0m
[1;36m# [0m
[1;36m### To submit job to [auto_free] queue, delete '-P Project-Name' line, and 
[1;36m###    activitate this line '-q auto_free' by changing to #PBS -q ... [0m

[1;32mcd $PBS_O_WORKDIR; [0m

[1;32m## define singularity container to use [0m
[1;32mimage=/app1/common/singularity-img/hopper/pytorch/pytorch_2.4.0a0-cuda_12.5.0_ngc_24.06.sif​ [0m

[1;32msingularity exec $image bash << EOF > stdout.$PBS_JOBID 2> stderr.$PBS_JOBID [0m

[1;32mpython -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.get_device_name())" 
[1;32m# or python script.py [0m

[1;32mEOF [0m

[1;31m  <<--- End at the above line with EOF ----- [0m

 Replace Project-Name with real project name allocated. You can check 
   the available project name via:  hpc project 

 Make necessary changes to the above script file [job1.txt], then 
 you can submit the job, check job status, and check cluster loading status by:

  # [1;32mqsub  job1.txt     ##--- To submit a batch job via script <job1.txt> [0m
  # [1;32mqstat -awn1        ##--- To list batch jobs with wide format and show exec nodes [0m
  # [1;32mqstat -fx job_id   ##--- To list details of a batch job <job_id> [0m
  # [1;32mhpc gstat          ##--- To check overall loading status of hopper cluster and queue  [0m


[1;31m More examples and instructions are available at this URL: [0m

 https://nusit.nus.edu.sg/hpc/ --> Vanda Onboarding.
